basic_details.job_title: TMC Fitness Trainer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Thane Municipal Corporation (ठाणे महानगरपालिका), through its Sports Department (क्रिडा विभाग), wants applications for 1 Fitness Trainer post for its men's professional cricket team. The post is filled on contract for 11 months, with a consolidated fixed honorarium of Rs.30,000/- per month. Applications go to the Sports Officer, Dadoji Konddev Krida Prekshagruh, Jawahar Baug Fire Brigade Road, Thane (W), and must be submitted by 5:00 pm on 29 October 2026.

qualification.details: There is one post: Fitness Trainer for the Thane Municipal Corporation men's cricket professional team. The notice lists these eligibility conditions: | Qualification: completion of the NIS (1 year/6 weeks) fitness course, OR a certificate showing at least 2 years' experience working as a Fitness Trainer in open national competitions. Character certificate: a character certificate for the applicant from an institution is required. Preference: candidates with at least 3 years' experience as a Fitness Trainer with a government or semi-government team (district/university/state/professional team) will be preferred. | The appointment is temporary, on a contract/agreement basis under the prescribed rules, for 11 months. The pay is a consolidated fixed honorarium of Rs.30,000/- per month. The person appointed will have no right to claim that the service be made permanent. | For the full eligibility conditions of the Fitness Trainer post, candidates should check the official notification.

important_instructions: A Fitness Trainer in the team who takes part in any competition other than one for the Thane Municipal Corporation team, or in a personal capacity, will be put on leave without pay for that period. If players complain about the Fitness Trainer, the complaint will be checked and the agreement will be cancelled. If any dispute arises in this matter, the decision of the Hon. Commissioner will be final and binding. By signing the form, you declare that the information is true. If any information is found to be false, incomplete or wrong, or if you are found ineligible before or after selection, your candidature or appointment can be cancelled at any stage and legal action can be taken against you.

content_sections.heading: About TMC Fitness Trainer
content_sections.text: Thane Municipal Corporation is the municipal body of Thane, Maharashtra. Under a resolution of its Hon. General Body to promote sports, it is forming a professional cricket team by adopting cricket players. The Fitness Trainer will work with this men's professional cricket team, which TMC is setting up to encourage the city's budding sportspersons.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their application by 5:00 pm on 29 October 2026. The notice names two addressees: The application paragraph says to submit it to: Sports Officer, Dadoji Konddev Krida Prekshagruh, Jawahar Baug Fire Brigade Road, Thane (W). The office address block reads: In-charge Deputy Commissioner (Sports), Dadoji Konddev Krida Prekshagruh, Jawahar Baug Fire Brigade Road, Thane (W). The notice does not print a PIN code, and it does not say whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand. On the envelope, write the following in large, bold letters: "ठाणे महानगरपालिका पुरुष क्रिकेट संघाकरिता फिटनेस ट्रेनर पदाकरिता नियुक्तीसाठी अर्ज केलेला आहे." (Application for appointment to the post of Fitness Trainer for the Thane Municipal Corporation men's cricket team.) Use the application form printed in the notification, which is addressed to the Hon. Commissioner, Thane Municipal Corporation, Thane. The form asks for: A passport-size photograph pasted in the photo box. Your full name (surname first), full address, contact number and email ID. Your date of birth and your age on the date of applying (years, months, days). Your educational qualifications (examination passed, university or board, year of passing, percentage or class) and any other qualifications. Your current job, if you have one (name and address of the institution, post, period from–to, total years), and your experience as a Fitness Trainer (institution, post, period). The languages you know (Marathi, Hindi, English). Details of any court, criminal or disciplinary case pending against you, or similar proceedings. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Fitness Trainer for the Thane Municipal Corporation men's cricket professional team. The notice lists these eligibility conditions: Qualification: completion of the NIS (1 year/6 weeks) fitness course, OR a certificate showing at least 2 years' experience working as a Fitness Trainer in open national competitions. Character certificate: a character certificate for the applicant from an institution is required. Preference: candidates with at least 3 years' experience as a Fitness Trainer with a government or semi-government team (district/university/state/professional team) will be preferred. The appointment is temporary, on a contract/agreement basis under the prescribed rules, for 11 months. The pay is a consolidated fixed honorarium of Rs.30,000/- per month. The person appointed will have no right to claim that the service be made permanent. For the full eligibility conditions of the Fitness Trainer post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: TMC Fitness Trainer Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties for the Fitness Trainer: Giving the players good physical training so that they stay physically fit is mandatory for the Fitness Trainer. The Fitness Trainer is responsible for checking that every player does the fitness work with discipline and according to the rules during practice. If a player avoids the fitness work or stays absent repeatedly, the Fitness Trainer must send a report for that day to the coach. If a player is injured during practice or a competition, the Fitness Trainer must stay with the player during treatment.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: The completed application form, with a photograph Your personal details and experience Attested photocopies of your certificates, such as the NIS fitness course certificate or the certificate of at least 2 years' experience in open national competitions A character certificate from an institution

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A Fitness Trainer in the team who takes part in any competition other than one for the Thane Municipal Corporation team, or in a personal capacity, will be put on leave without pay for that period. If players complain about the Fitness Trainer, the complaint will be checked and the agreement will be cancelled. If any dispute arises in this matter, the decision of the Hon. Commissioner will be final and binding. By signing the form, you declare that the information is true. If any information is found to be false, incomplete or wrong, or if you are found ineligible before or after selection, your candidature or appointment can be cancelled at any stage and legal action can be taken against you.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TMC Recruitment 2026 for Fitness Trainer?
faq.answer: There is 1 Fitness Trainer post for the Thane Municipal Corporation men's cricket professional team. The notice does not print a number, so the one post counts as 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the TMC Fitness Trainer application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by 5:00 pm on 29 October 2026 at the Sports Department address in Thane (W).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the TMC Fitness Trainer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have completed the NIS (1 year/6 weeks) fitness course, or have a certificate showing at least 2 years' experience as a Fitness Trainer in open national competitions. A character certificate from an institution is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the TMC Fitness Trainer?
faq.answer: The Fitness Trainer gets a consolidated fixed honorarium of Rs.30,000/- per month for the 11-month contract.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the TMC Fitness Trainer post?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form in the notification and attach your personal details, your experience and attested photocopies of your certificates. Submit it to the Sports Officer, Dadoji Konddev Krida Prekshagruh, Jawahar Baug Fire Brigade Road, Thane (W), by 5:00 pm on 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What should I write on the envelope for the TMC Fitness Trainer application?
faq.answer: Write "ठाणे महानगरपालिका पुरुष क्रिकेट संघाकरिता फिटनेस ट्रेनर पदाकरिता नियुक्तीसाठी अर्ज केलेला आहे." in large, bold letters. It means you are applying for appointment as Fitness Trainer for the Thane Municipal Corporation men's cricket team.

faq.question: Q7. Is the TMC Fitness Trainer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary contract appointment for 11 months, and the person appointed will have no right to claim a permanent post.

faq.question: Q8. Who gets preference for the TMC Fitness Trainer post?
faq.answer: Candidates with at least 3 years' experience as a Fitness Trainer with a government or semi-government team (district/university/state/professional team) will be preferred.

faq.question: Q9. Can the TMC Fitness Trainer work in other competitions?
faq.answer: A Fitness Trainer who takes part in any competition other than one for the Thane Municipal Corporation team, or in a personal capacity, will be put on leave without pay for that period.
